function.name: space_star_info

information.description: The type of information needed about the star.

message.content:
The largest planet that has been observed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**.  
It is still forming around its host star and has a radius of roughly **2.5 – 3 times that of Jupiter**, making it the biggest planet we know of in the entire observable universe.
